method: The manager visually inspected every final page in the 15 six-page contact sheets (37 formal, 17 rationale, 30 ECS pages). Full-size inspection additionally covered all three covers; formal pages 6, 11, 13, 15 and 16 for the comparison-space reference, preserved N=0 selector, empty-support text, response equation and lifecycle tables; rationale page 17 for the complete authority paragraph; and ECS pages 10 and 30 for profile, response and handoff vocabularies. No clipping, overlap, malformed equation, broken glyph or unreadable table was found.
